_comment: REHEARSAL AUTHORIZATION ARTIFACT (example). Produced only by a SUCCESSFUL staging or clone rehearsal, then reviewed and signed off by the owner. The release engine refuses a production run without one, and re-verifies every pinned value against the live repository and toolchain before requesting a password. Contains no secrets.
_verification_notes: tested_head_sha must equal the repository HEAD at production run time.
purge_sql_sha256 must equal the target manifest's purge_sql_sha256.
migration_manifest_sha256 is recomputed from supabase/ops/purge-manifest-v147.ts and must match.
staging_pg_major must equal the target's required_pg_major.
client_tool_versions must equal the psql/pg_dump majors resolved at run time.
ca_sha256 must equal the target's committed CA pin.
restore_proven, trigger_reconciliation_proven and rollback_proven must all be true.
owner_go_decision must be exactly GO, recorded in ADR-001.
Any mismatch stops with STOP_PRODUCTION_RELEASE_NOT_AUTHORIZED before any credential is requested.
